parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Paper chromatography is a technique that can be used to separate and identify different chloroplast pigments.

Describe how the **results** of paper chromatography can be used to identify chloroplast pigments.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Carotene and xanthophyll are chloroplast pigments.

Describe the role played by these pigments in photosynthesis.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The light-dependent stage of photosynthesis produces ATP and reduced NADP, which are used in the light-independent stage.

Describe the **light-independent** stage of photosynthesis.
